text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-gateway` (policy: high-error-rate). Trigger: 5xx rate > 15% for 3m. Routed to oncall -> Sam. Incident ID: PD-78901.

PagerDuty: Alert details: severity=high, escalation_policy=primary->secondary->manager, last_trigger=2098765430.

Sam: got it, looking now. tracing into gateway logs.

Sam: quick snapshot — 502s originate from model-proxy timeouts, lots of `kv-cache` misses.

Jia: pinging runtime team. any rate-limiter changes pushed in last hour?

Sam: nothing obvious in deploys, checking autoscale and qps.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: primary did not ack within 2m -> escalated to secondary (Eli) at 2098765438.

Eli: I'm on call, taking over. Sam — can you paste the tail of the proxy logs?

Sam: sure — gist: 

```
[2026-11-03T16:23:40Z] proxy.go:487 ERROR upstream timeout for model-rt-3 (req=9.8s)
[2026-11-03T16:23:41Z] cache.go:112 WARN KV miss for key=ctx:abc123
[2026-11-03T16:23:42Z] router.go:223 ERROR no healthy worker for model-rt-3
```

Jia: looks like worker OOMs + cold cache. Did a scheduled preemptible cleanup run hit earlier?

Sam: infra autoscaler shows node churn ~16:23 — several preemptible gpus reclaimed. That lines up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: secondary acked at 2098765440. Manager Kate paged as escalation next in policy.

Kate: I'm awake, joining. what's customer impact?

Eli: initial estimate — ~35% of requests to inference-gateway in eu-west failed with 502 over last 5m. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (chat & streaming). Potential impact: checkout and content generation for two customers (acme-corp, storyforge).

Mike: confirming Storyforge is showing user-facing errors in metrics (alerts from customer-monitoring).

Sam: mitigation plan: 1) scale up warm pool for model-rt-3 (add 4 dedicated pods), 2) disable preemptible cleanup for gateway zone for 10m, 3) enable fallback routing to model-rt-2 (quantized) for non-latency-critical routes.

Eli: I'll run the scaling. Sam — prepare routing change and rollback plan. Jia — coordinate infra exemptions. Kate — please determine if we should notify customers.

Sam: executing scale command now: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/model-rt-3-warmpool --replicas=6 -n inference
```

Eli: scaling started. pods arriving 2098765446 -> 2098765452.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: manager escalated notification acknowledged by Kate at 2098765453.

Sam: enabling fallback routing rule in edge-router for non-streaming requests: 
```
PATCH /config/routing
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "fallback": "model-rt-2", "match": "!streaming" }
```

Jia: applied infra exemption — preemptible cleanup suppressed for zone eu-west-1 for 15m.

Eli: pods are warm, healthchecks green. 502s dropped from 36% -> 4% in next 90s.

Mike: verified client metrics — user-facing errors reduced, Storyforge alerted success.

Kate: good mitigation. action items: postmortem to include why preemptible cleanup overlapped high qps window, improve warm pool margins, and add automatic fallback routing when worker count < threshold. Also review PD escalation timing — primary didn't ack in window.

Sam: creating incident ticket PD-78901-INV with timeline. I'll capture logs and commands run.

Eli: handoff: I'll stay on until 2100 UTC local to confirm stable. Sam — you can unassign if you need.

Sam: okay unassigning. leaving notes in ticket.

PagerDuty: Incident PD-78901 marked acknowledged -> resolved at 2098765459 after stability checks.

Kate: thanks everyone. quick post-call: @Sam @Eli @Jia @Mike — please add short notes to the ticket with exact timestamps & PRs. I'll triage severity for customer communication.

Sam: will do. :thumbsup:

Eli: leaving an immediate follow-up: add an automated check to pause preemptible cleanup if active 95th percentile qps > threshold. putting draft in #eng-infra.

Jia: i'll schedule a 30-min blameless review tomorrow.

Mike: notifying customer success to prepare templates for ACME/Storyforge.

incident-bot: System note: thread closed for paging updates.
